title: Signal: Cipher initialized with a zero-filled static IV in javascript — review required
scope: Single-line match on a zero-filled IV in javascript.
limitations: Lexical: matches a zero-filled buffer passed on the same line as createCipheriv; IVs built elsewhere are out of scope.

examples.line: # audit: const c = crypto.createCipheriv("aes-256-cbc", key, Buffer.alloc(16, 0)); present
# verified: const c = crypto.createCipheriv("aes-256-gcm", key, crypto.randomBytes(12));

fpNotes: Test vectors and fixed-vector interoperability tests are the accepted false positives.
